hard_separation.civic_preparation: Universal obligation to prepare every young person for citizenship.
hard_separation.suffrage: Franchise eligibility is a legal/democratic design question — never an examination, certification, GPA, service-hour, or political-knowledge gate.

hypotheses.text: After establishing robust universal civic education and participation infrastructure, lowering the voting age to 16 for local elections may strengthen lifelong civic participation and connect young citizens more directly to schools, municipalities, and other institutions that immediately govern their lives.
hypotheses.prerequisite_infrastructure_note: Hypothesis investigation is sequenced after universal civic preparation infrastructure is mature. Civic preparation is not a personal eligibility test for any voter.
hypotheses.obsolete_framing_rejected: Complete civics certification / pass a test / finish service hours to earn the ballot at 16.

governance.reason: Separate hypothesis from civic-education obligation; no franchise gatekeeping; not a new principle.
